title: Exploring Dynamics User Groups at DynamicsCon 2025
summary: DynamicsCon 2025 is a conference offering 350+ sessions where professionals in the Dynamics community gather to network, share knowledge, and learn from each other despite being competitors in the business. Dynamics User Groups (DUG) provide local networking and free training opportunities for users and partners.
key_points: DynamicsCon 2025 takes place May 14-16 in Chicago with 350+ sessions across three days
Dynamics professionals compete for clients but form a cohesive community united by shared platform knowledge and continuous learning needs
Dynamics User Groups (DUG) facilitate networking between users and partners while offering free training at local meetups
The community values both technical expertise and the social connections formed around shared interests in the platform

quotes.text: DynamicsCon and the Dynamics User Groups (DUG for short) work hard to connect users and partners together to help both grow.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core purpose of user groups in building professional community and facilitating growth
